title: oss-repository-conventions audit finding
description: One JSON object per finding emitted in audit mode. Files using this schema are NDJSON: one object per line. See output-format.md for the prose spec.

domain.description: The capability that owns the check (its directory name).

check.description: Kebab-case check id, unique within the domain, matching a check in the owning capability's Audit section.

severity.description: Severity from oss-health-rubric.md — a property of the check, not the repo's enthusiasm.

status.description: Outcome against the criterion. skip = the check is inapplicable to this repo (excluded from the score, not failed).

file.description: Source path the finding was read from, or null when not declared / inferred.

scorecard.description: Optional OpenSSF Scorecard check name this maps to, when one exists.

scaffold.description: Optional capability directory that can generate the fix (e.g. capabilities/licensing).
